section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the Zohar's teaching that the sun's setting into the west (Malchus) is its true place, because the ultimate purpose of Atzilus is the creation of Biyah, where the essential Divine dwelling is specifically in the lowest world.
section.t: And based on this, one can understand what is brought
regarding the matter of "when the sun sets," the teaching of the Zohar
on the verse,
"And to its place it yearns, it shines there,"
"When the sun goes to the west, this west is called the place of the sun, etc."
And the explanation of this is known,
"west" is Malchus
(as per the statement,
"The Shechinah is in the west"),
and "when the sun goes to the west" is the drawing down and descent of Zeir Anpin
(the sun)
into Malchus,
until within Malchus, as it becomes a source for Biyah, and until "the light of Atzilus is sunk,"
and nevertheless, "this west is called the place of the sun, etc.,"
for this is its true place
(because the true intention in the emanation of Atzilus is for the sake of the creation of Biyah),
and to the extent that specifically there "it shines,"
for the primary and true matter of shining is specifically in Biyah.
And as is explained in the holy Tanya,
that the higher worlds are in the category of descent from the light of His countenance,
but the worlds of Biyah,
and particularly this lowest world, below which there is no lower,
become a dwelling place for Him,
a dwelling place for His Essence (Awtsmoos)
(similar to a person's dwelling, where the person's essence dwells in the dwelling),
and to the extent that, as is known,
the created being
(which in its feeling, its existence is from itself)
is a likeness of the true yesh (existence).
And this is the meaning of "the mitzvah is from the time the sun sets,"
for the matter of "the mitzvah" is to illuminate the darkness of Biyah
(the setting of the sun of Atzilus),
for specifically through this the shining occurs,
and to the extent of the revelation and dwelling of the Essence (Awtsmoos),
as above.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the "setting of the sun" on a lower level refers to the creation of the husks (kelipos), and the resulting "shining" reveals a light higher than any previous revelation, completing the purpose of a dwelling place in the lower realms.
section.t: And it can be said that the matter of "when the sun sets" on a lower level refers to the creation of the husks (kelipos),
a setting incomparable to that of the light of holiness.
And since whatever is higher descends lower
(as above in section 2),
the shining that comes through this setting is a shining of a light more elevated even than the shining that comes through the aforementioned setting of the sun of Atzilus.
[And this is similar to the superiority in the creation of the particular yesh of Biyah
(the setting of particular Atzilus)
over the superiority of the creation of the general Biyah
(the setting of general Atzilus),
for in the creation of the yesh of Biyah
(the particular)
specifically, the power of the Essence (Awtsmoos) is revealed,
and within Biyah itself, the primary revelation of the power of the Essence (Awtsmoos) is specifically in the creation of physical yesh].
And as per the statement,
"When the sitra achra is subdued, the glory of the Holy One, blessed be He, is elevated in all worlds,"
for through the existence of the sitra achra
(by means of the setting of the sun of holiness),
and the sitra achra is subdued and the sitra achra is transformed,
a most elevated light is drawn down,
a light that is above the category of revelation,
which is therefore called by the name "elevation" (istalkus).
And specifically through this, the intention that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed.
And in order for this intention to be completed, the existence of evil was brought into being
(as our sages, of blessed memory, said
on the verse,
"Awesome in deeds upon the children of man"),
for this is that "the Holy One, blessed be He, built worlds and destroyed them"
which refers to the building of the world of Tohu and its shattering,
so that man
[You are called 'man'
'I will make man' above]
should refine the sparks
(that were not refined through the refinement above)
and rectify them and elevate them through his service,
and specifically through this, the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the two interpretations of "until the foot is removed from the market," one referring to the holy desire for a dwelling place and the other to the public domain of separation, which are interconnected because the world was created with free choice to allow for the ultimate fulfillment of that desire.
section.t: And this is the explanation of "until the foot is removed from the market": The first interpretation,
that it is a matter in holiness,
"market" (shuk),
"His legs are pillars of marble"
—this is the world that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired
to create.
And "foot"
(from the market)
is the matter of the three feet (regalim),
the most elevated level in holiness, as our sages, of blessed memory, said,
"Just as one comes to see, so too one comes to be seen, and just as one comes to be seen, so too one comes to see."
And the second interpretation is,
"market" and "public domain,"
"public domain" is the mountains of separation,
and to the extent that in this market there are Tarmudai, who rebel against the kingdom of Heaven
(Tarmud is the letters of 'moredet'—rebellious),
and "foot from the market" is the foot of the Tarmudai,
meaning that in the market there are rebels and they also walk in it
(for "foot" indicates
walking),
and from and through the market.
And these two interpretations are connected to each other,
for that which the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to create the world
(the first interpretation of "market")
is so that He would have a dwelling place in the lower realms,
in this lowest world, below which there is no lower in terms of the concealment of His light,
and therefore the creation occurred in a manner of "let us make"
—plural language
[the public domain
(the second interpretation of "market")]
and "whoever wishes to err may err,"
for in order that there be "and you shall choose life"
(the matter of choice),
there must be a place given for error.
And specifically through this, that the creation of the world was in a manner of "let us make"—plural language,
the matter of the public domain,
and man, through his service, transforms the world so that it becomes a private domain for the Unique One of the world,
through this, so to speak, "His legs" (shokav)—the desire of the Holy One, blessed be He, in the creation of the world that He would have a dwelling place in the lower realms—is completed.
